name: Medical office building
summary: Outpatient medical office (physician suites, exam rooms, light procedure and imaging) delivered complete: shell plus typical medical build-out with heavier HVAC, plumbing at every exam room and higher electrical density. Public data disagree widely — RSMeans national project data (~$250/SF in 2022) vs. Cumming 2025 metro ranges ($400–1,050) — so the mid is a reasoned blend; verify against a local estimate.

typicalSize.method: Judgment: one- to three-story MOBs; RSMeans models use 7,000 SF (small) — typical developer MOBs 20,000–80,000 SF.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Derived: 5 spaces/1,000 SF × ≈350 SF per space = 1,750 SF parking per 1,000 SF; a 2-story building at ≈25–35% overall FAR ≈ 11,000 SF/acre.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per GSF; typical zoning for medical office 4–6 per 1,000 SF (higher than general office).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Complete MOB (shell + standard medical build-out) incl. typical sitework. Two evidence clusters: (a) RSMeans national data — 2022 median $250 (e2) and 2019 model $198–217 (e3) — which after escalation to 2025 and ≈$20–25 sitework (e5) imply ≈$300–330; (b) Cumming 2025 metro ranges excl. sitework — Nashville $400–620, Dallas $450–690 (e1) — midpoints $510–570 in lower-cost metros. Mid = $400 ≈ midpoint of the two clusters. Low = $290 ≈ cluster (a). High = $620 ≈ Cumming Dallas/Nashville upper range. Evidence years 2019, 2022, 2025 — mid expressed in 2025 dollars by judgment; verify.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC and fee; shell + typical medical TI; excludes medical equipment, furniture, imaging equipment, land, soft costs, off-sites.

systemSplit.method: Derived. MEP from RSMeans 2022 medical clinic medians (e2): plumbing 6.65% → 22 7%, mechanical 10.9% → 23 12% (incl. controls), electrical 11.4% → 26 10% + 27 2% (+28 1%). Sitework 9% (≈$36/SF on $400) consistent with office sitework $14–33/SF (e5). Remaining architectural share split by judgment for a 1–3 story steel/masonry MOB with heavy interior partitioning (09 12%, 06 casework 4%).

cost.method: Office sitework per GSF $14–33 (Kirksey, e5) scaled up for 5/1,000 parking (vs 4/1,000).

lineItems.name: Imaging suite: radiation/RF shielding and structural/MEP prep (CT/MRI)

cost.method: Derived judgment (no public source fetched): lead-lined X-ray/CT room ≈ $50k–150k; MRI RF cage, magnetic shielding, quench pipe and structural prep ≈ $300k–800k. Excludes the imaging equipment itself.

lineItems.notes: Turn on if the program includes CT/MRI; equipment is owner FF&E.

lineItems.name: Emergency / standby generator

cost.method: From _blocks/specialty-mep.json emergency-generator; 150 kW default for a 40,000-SF MOB (judgment).

lineItems.notes: Required where procedures use sedation/life-safety loads beyond battery egress lighting.

lineItems.name: Hydraulic passenger/stretcher elevator
lineItems.notes: Inside baseline for 2–4 story MOBs (one must be stretcher-sized).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived judgment: exam-room furniture/equipment, waiting room and staff furniture ≈ $20–60/SF; imaging and specialty equipment excluded.

pctOfHard.method: Derived. A/E 9% (RSMeans medical office model fee, e4) + permits/plan review 1–2% + survey/geotech/testing 1% + insurance/legal/taxes 2–3% + developer fee 3–5% + leasing/marketing 2–4% + owner PM 1–2%.

softCosts.notes: Medical equipment planning (≈0.5–1%) applies when the developer delivers equipped suites.

design.method: Medical programs change late (equipment, tenant mix): slightly above office norms.

hard.method: Typical owner hard contingency for new healthcare-adjacent work.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min ≈ RSMeans 1/4-quartile clinic ($188, 2022) escalated + sitework + 18% soft; max ≈ Cumming 10-metro high median ($875) × 1.3 soft.

source.title: Market Analysis Q4 2025 — Typical Construction Cost Range (Cost Per Unit 2025)

evidence.quote: Healthcare | Medical Office Building | SF: Dallas $450–$690; Nashville $400–$620; Denver $490–$750; Chicago $590–$900
evidence.scopeNotes: Values are the Dallas column; Nashville $400–620, Denver $490–750, 10-metro median $570–875. Cumming notes: "Costs represent new-build projects for complete structure shell and interior build-out to five feet out and excludes sitework." Excludes land, professional fees, permits, FF&E, soft costs.

source.title: 2022 Project Costs — 50 17 00 Project Costs per S.F.

evidence.quote: Medical Clinics & Offices, Total Project Costs per S.F.: 1/4 = 188, Median = 250, 3/4 = 330 (Plumbing 6.65%, Mechanical 10.90%, Electrical 11.40% of total, medians).
evidence.scopeNotes: Completed medical clinics & offices, January 2022 national dollars, incl. contractor OH&P; sitework scope not stated.

source.title: Construction Cost Estimates for a Medical Office, 1 Story in National, US (2019 RSMeans data)

evidence.scopeNotes: Basic-component model, excl. sitework. Hard cost = SubTotal + 25% contractor fees (open $197.75, union $217.02). 2-story model: $191.90–$210.81.

evidence.scopeNotes: Office proxy for on-site work per GSF (Dallas $21–33, Austin $20–27).

openQuestions: RSMeans and Cumming disagree by ~2× for the same building type; a national MOB benchmark (e.g., Revista or a recent state CON filing) would settle the mid.
